principles: Known undesirable values may eliminate a candidate.
Unknown or missing values remain eligible and reduce confidence.
Each field has one defined owner and meaning.

definitions.LOA_ft: Published length overall used for display and dimensional filtering.
definitions.HullLength_ft: Molded or nominal hull length only when materially distinct from LOA; otherwise omitted.
definitions.Configuration: Physical layout or version, such as Sedan, Flybridge, Aft Cabin, or Classic Trawler.
definitions.DataConfidence: Confidence in the model-level data. Unknown is explicit and must not cause exclusion.
definitions.ResearchStatus: Progress of the model research workflow, independent of suitability.

retiredFields.Length_ft: Retired in favour of LOA_ft; unique hull-length distinctions retained in HullLength_ft.
retiredFields.IdentityResolution: Moved to boat registry as Resolution.
retiredFields.IdentityResolutionNotes: Moved to boat registry as ResolutionNotes.
